## About
AMS Autowerks is a car repair and maintenance shop on Cantor Ave in Linden, NJ. We handle the regular service your car needs, plus tuning, upgrades and body work under one roof.
The team is small, and the owner works on the floor alongside the guys. Reviewers mention Diogo and Fernando by name, and one customer wrote that the shop is full of high end and rare cars, which makes it a pleasure to walk around.
Our Google rating is 4 from 107 reviews. Stop by or give us a call during the week or on Saturday.

## Services
- Maintenance and tuning: Routine maintenance and tuning work, including on performance cars.
- Engine, transmission and Haldex oil service: Fluid service for the engine, transmission and Haldex system on Audi models.
- Upgrades: Upgrade work, with mechanics who are happy to talk through what you might want to do next.
- Body shop: An in-house body shop, so body repairs can be handled along with mechanical work.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: We are open Saturday from 10 AM to 5 PM and closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you do body work too?
A: Yes. We have a body shop, so body repairs can be handled along with mechanical work.

Q: Can you service my Audi?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in an Audi for engine, transmission and Haldex oil service.
